s.n: Snow day toastie fingers with tomato soup
s.note: Charlie's snow days in the Colorado mountains
s.how: Fry 1 diced onion in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes, add 2 x 400g tins crushed tomatoes, 300ml chicken stock and 1 tsp sugar and simmer 15 minutes. Blitz smooth and stir in 50ml cream. Spread 8 slices bread with mustard and make 4 sandwiches with 150g ham and 150g grated cheddar. Butter the outsides and fry 3 minutes a side until golden. Cut into fingers and serve with cups of soup.

Slowly fry 2 sliced onions in 20g butter for 15 minutes until golden. Simmer 8 frankfurts in water for 5 minutes, then grill 2 minutes for colour. Warm 8 pretzel buns or soft rolls in the oven for 4 minutes. Split, add a frankfurt to each, then top with the onions, a squeeze of American mustard, sliced pickles and 80g grated cheddar.

m.n: Frost family roast beef and Yorkshires
m.note: the family Christmas Jack finally gets to share
m.how: Rub a 1.5kg beef topside with mustard, rosemary and salt and roast at 200C for 1 hour for medium rare, with 1.2kg parboiled potatoes in oil on another tray. Rest 15 minutes. Turn the oven to 220C. Whisk 2 eggs, 100g plain flour and 150ml milk. Heat 1 tsp oil in each of 8 muffin holes for 5 minutes, pour in the batter and bake 20 minutes without opening. Make gravy from the juices with 1 tbsp flour and 400ml stock.

w.note: Jack coming back as a snowman
w.how: Beat 125g butter and 150g caster sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk. Divide between 12 cases and bake at 180C for 18 minutes. Cool. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar and 1 tsp vanilla until fluffy and white. Dome onto each cupcake and roll in 80g desiccated coconut. Press in 2 chocolate chips for eyes and a small orange lolly for a nose.

d.note: the magic harmonica that brings Jack back
d.how: Heat 1L full cream milk with 1 cinnamon stick until steaming. Remove the cinnamon and whisk in 150g chopped white chocolate and 1 tsp vanilla until smooth and frothy. Pour into 4 mugs, top with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream and sprinkle with 2 tbsp desiccated coconut so it looks like fresh snow.
